translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: “Kunengfocna nga tosofocna, ni neanna hania edengunuba negenggec.”
Anu Paurongo hebiraio yoacfusing deu negemma ning kpedacgec.

Nga ye tahockema edeyunuec, “Ni yudangic, Kirikia bangecfu Tarso taonnu fingecma imohai kecma yadiai. Kpoukpou Gamarie yeac bageau kecbare yeng kisicfocnina yeneac singyoac sasawa kpounenu negendarai. Amma ngeni yofinenggac faka andae, imoc ifingoc Anutungo negengngereenubeso dema yoac imoc seria yombong mekefai.
Amma ngicngac momoc sing gboria modacgec yunukporac ayemmema witicyunuma witicamau faiyunukecma yunukpebuc ayemmegecdeac deaingoc.

Womong garengtoa nga yudangic gamangtoangina yeneng neac hepuc naric amma hania ifia dekperagibau. Yenennoc kibi mong ohogec, imocac siriha yofi: Ngicngac sing gboriau modacgec ni meficyunuma witicyunuma Yerusarennu meyunu haanduae. Nga turunga yemmegecdeac tosofocngina Damasko kecandae, yenearu mekembadeac nenggec.
Ifi dema sing kengkecma wenac dzongiau isoc Damasko ama mewegenebare, imohaingoc kurumennunac kperagitoango gereagoc mama nerarannuec.
Nerarannuu bangecfu todingge kpe fema yoac mong yofi fingeru negenai, ‘Sauro Sauro, ge nocac nukporac anemma kecannec?’
Ifi negemma yofi deai, ‘Kebu ge merac?’ Deba yofi edenuec, ‘Nukporac angannec, Yesu Nadzaretenac ninoc.’
Ngic nigoc kecgec, yeni kperagitoa henggec, yoac edenuec imoc ine obohogec.
Obohogec neng kpesiai, ‘Kebu, noc wiac ambadeac denennec.’ deba Kebungo yofi edenuec, ‘Ge yacma Damasko kenna wiac anna dema degecdegena, imoc edegugecde.’
Nga kperagitoango kicnau neraranggeu fiba kundung kpeec. Ifi amba ngicfocna yeneng marinau mema Damasko menu kenggec.
Ihai ngic mong kefec kpara Anania, yeng dedeseriyoac henanggema memodacma kefu yudangic taong imohaingoc kecgec, yeni sasawango yeac negenggec ngereec.
Ngic yennoc nearu wegenac hasikema yofi edenuec, ‘Tosona Sauro, ge kicga fitegecna.’ ifi deu ihaingoc kicna fitegecma ye henai.
Ifi dema yoac yofi edenuec, ‘Kisicfocnina yeneac Anutu, yeng uaya mena dema edeedzacgu anu geng Dindingac mingina hemma yeac enacfunac yoac negennadeac meisingguec.
Ge yeac siducdede amma wiac hennegeng annec, siduc imoc bangecsoc ngic edeyunu kembesena.
Negennec, ge naso mi ukuna! Yacma Yesuac kpac kpacna yeac kpacfu mitidoku nadzicma kopocsicga dzuacna.’
Ifi deu Yerusarennu dzigenema Anutuac womonnu emma numuba kicna merecgeu Kebu henai.
Hemba yoac yofi edenuec, ‘Ama yomocac ngicngac yeni geac enacfunac neac siducna negemma wagecde, imocac amma ge Yerusareng wama bic kenna.’
Ifi deu yoac yofi meremmiai, ‘Kebu, ge negensinggugec, ni witicfu meyunuma kpekpeturangamea amea meyunu emma dzikacngo yunukefai, imoc bic negendae.
Amma siducdedega Stefano sacgoc homemea kpegecdeac ngakpingina hesigec garenggebare kpegec negemba ngereec, yeni imoc negendacdae.’
Ifi deba Kebungo yofi edenuec, ‘Kpahac, ni bangec hereau bangec monnunac ngicngac, yenearu sueguba kennadeac ge bic efaima kenna.’”

Ngic yeni kedzac kpemagec, Paurongo yudangic wayunuma bangec monnunac ngicngac, yenearu kenudeac warac Anutungo edeec, yoac imoc edeyunuu yeni seriangoc arohogec, “Ngic ifia imoc kekeha kpac ambeso. Ye kefu naric mi ande.”
Ifi dema arohoma ngatangyunuu ngakpingina herea hesima yube figec enu meuku anggec.
Anggec garengtoango deu wasai yeneng Pauro amanginau meenggec. Amma ngic yeni nocac homac arohomigec faka negenudeac dzikacngo kpegec kopocsiha deficgeudeac desiyemmeec.

Desiyemmeu yeni dzikacngo kpegecdeac witicngo mendangge dzegema taigec. Taigec Paurongo enarangina yofi dema kpesimiec, “Ngeni ngic mong romangic yeneac arennu torokpema kecde, ye yoacfu mi faifai manganaac areng desima dzikacngo naric kpegecde me? Imoc singyoacngina kpede.”
Ifi deu enaranginango garengtoaaru kemma edeec, “Dafi ambesonga? Ngic ye romangic yeneac arennu torokpeec kecde.”
Ifi deu garengtoango Pauroaru kemma kpesimiec, “Dena, ge foracngoc romangic arennu torokpema kecnec me?” deu Paurongo deec, “Imoc fora ni romangic yeneac arennunac.”
Ifi deu yeng deec, “Ni hiedzo homac faiba kirecgenuu romangic anai.” Ifi deu Paurongo deec, “Ni ine fingec fingecna romangic yeneac arennu fingerai.”
Ifi deu yeni imohaingoc Pauro faka ammibeso degec, imoc wagec. Wasai garengtoa yeng ine yofi negenec “Pauro ye romangic. Ni ngic ifia witicfu faidua, imoc naric kpac!” Ye ifi negemma kengec kpeec.

Wereckengau wasai garengtoango yudangic yeni Pauro hania damocac yoacfu faigec, imocac hania yombong negenudeac womong gareng enara nga yudangic tutumangtoanginaac memba deu sasawa kpedzucnegec. Ammanu Pauro yungecma hesicke kemema kpedzucnegec, yeneac kicfu faiec.
